purpose: Prove the Minion Skill Registry contract locally: three Council Skill records (CSK-LOCAL-*) declare trigger, allowed context, required inputs, authority class, approval requirements, proof owed, update policy, and status (one active, one deprecated, one suspended). Two recommendation scenarios exercise status-governed use: recommending the deprecated skill is FLAGGED for human review, and recommending the suspended skill is PREVENTED. Each outcome is receipt-backed and the outcome is DERIVED from the skill record's status and authority class, not read from a self-asserted boolean. Receipts here are local contract evidence only, and every live mutation stays receipt-gated to Epic 2.

skillRegistryRun.authorityBasis: local non-tenant Story 5.1 contract validation; skill registry use is status-governed and any live write stays deferred to Epic 2

receiptVerbPolicy.localExtensionNote: The manifest com_receiptverb vocabulary has no skill-scoped flag or prevent verb. The FLAG outcome reuses the manifest verb 'held' (the recommendation is held for human review) and the PREVENT outcome reuses the manifest verb 'policy_denied' (the recommendation is denied by policy). com_result and com_before_state/com_after_state disambiguate the recommendation outcome from a Work Item state move. This is a documented local extension, NOT a claim that the skill registry owns Work Item workflow state; guards.noWorkItemStateChangeInThisSlice remains true.

skills.com_name: Drift scan - flag affected Work Items for review
skills.com_trigger: A source record that already produced Work Items or rationale in Story 1.3/1.4 is observed to have drifted (new com_source_version_ref or a superseding capture); the skill fires to flag only the affected Work Items for review.
skills.com_allowed_context: Source drift runs over Story 1.1/1.2/1.4 source records; the skill must not run over zero-item sources or sources that produced no rationale.
skills.com_required_inputs: A drifted source record id, the observed com_source_version_ref and com_content_hash, and the set of Work Items linked to that source in any source role.
skills.com_approval_requirements: No per-use human approval required; the skill is pre-approved to flag affected Work Items for review only. Any com_state_group move driven by the flag still requires a separate receipt-gated mutation (Epic 2 Story 2.3).
skills.com_proof_owed: A source_drifted receipt naming the drifted source, the new version ref, and each flagged Work Item; the flag must be surfaced as a review-needed indicator, not a state change.
skills.com_update_policy: Trigger and proof obligation changes require a new Council Skill record with a new CSK id superseding this one via com_status=superseded; the prior record and its receipts are never edited (append-only).
skills.provenanceNote: Trigger observed in the manual meeting note CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001 where Doug moved the checklist deadline; referenced as provenance only, the skill itself is minted in this slice.

skills.com_name: Legacy summary - single-line work item titles (deprecated)
skills.com_trigger: A proposed Work Item has an empty or single-line com_title and the source summary is short enough to summarize without authoring new rationale.
skills.com_allowed_context: Single-message source records only; must not run over threads, meetings, or multi-item extractions.
skills.com_required_inputs: A proposed Work Item id and its primary source record id.
skills.com_approval_requirements: Every use requires explicit human (Doug) approval before the summary is applied; the skill may not auto-execute.
skills.com_proof_owed: An approved receipt recording the human approver, the Work Item, and the summarized title; a recommendation made while this skill is deprecated must be flagged for review rather than executed.
skills.com_update_policy: Deprecated in favor of a richer multi-line summarization skill; status may move to retired only through a new receipt-backed mutation (Epic 2). The prior trigger and proof obligation stay unchanged.
skills.provenanceNote: Legacy registry entry predating the Story 1.1-1.4 captures; no single source record is cited as provenance.

skills.com_name: Outbound send - draft and send a reply on behalf of a Minion (suspended)
skills.com_trigger: A Work Item resolves to an outbound reply or message that a Minion could draft and send on a human's behalf.
skills.com_allowed_context: Outlook/Teams message sources only; must not run over internal-only or sensitive-labeled sources.
skills.com_required_inputs: A resolved Work Item id, the target conversation ref, and an explicit human approval to send.
skills.com_approval_requirements: Every use requires explicit human approval BEFORE the skill drafts or sends; the skill must ask before use and may never auto-send.
skills.com_proof_owed: An external_action_requested receipt naming the outbound target and the human approver; while suspended the skill may not be recommended at all and any recommendation must be prevented.
skills.com_update_policy: Suspended pending tenant outbound-action guardrails; status may move back to active only through a new receipt-backed mutation (Epic 2) after the guardrails are verified. The prior trigger and proof obligation stay unchanged.
skills.provenanceNote: Suspended registry entry; provenance is the outbound-action guardrail gap, not a single source record.

recommendationScenarios.recommendationRationale: A Minion recommended the legacy single-line summarization skill for a short Work Item title; the registry evaluates the recommendation against the skill record's status and authority class before any use.
recommendationScenarios.outcomeRationale: The recommended skill CSK-LOCAL-LEGACY-SUMMARIZE-001 is deprecated (com_status=deprecated) and manual_only, so the recommendation is FLAGGED for human review rather than executed; the deprecated status governs use and the flag is receipt-backed.

recommendationScenarios.recommendationRationale: A Minion recommended the outbound send skill to draft and send a reply; the registry evaluates the recommendation against the skill record's status and authority class before any use.
recommendationScenarios.outcomeRationale: The recommended skill CSK-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-SEND-001 is suspended (com_status=suspended), so the recommendation is PREVENTED entirely; the suspended status governs use and the prevent is receipt-backed, consistent with the ask_before_use authority class which already forbids auto-execution.

receipts.com_authority_basis: local non-tenant Story 5.1 contract validation; deprecated skill recommendation is flagged for human review and any live write stays deferred to Epic 2
receipts.com_decision_rationale: The registry evaluated a recommendation to use CSK-LOCAL-LEGACY-SUMMARIZE-001. The skill record's com_status is deprecated and com_authority_class is manual_only, so the recommendation is held for human review (FLAGGED) rather than executed. The outcome is derived from the skill record, not a self-asserted boolean. No live tenant write was performed; any live skill-use mutation is a receipt-gated deferred update.

receipts.com_authority_basis: local non-tenant Story 5.1 contract validation; suspended skill recommendation is prevented by policy and any live write stays deferred to Epic 2
receipts.com_decision_rationale: The registry evaluated a recommendation to use CSK-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-SEND-001. The skill record's com_status is suspended, so the recommendation is denied by policy (PREVENTED) entirely; no use is permitted while the skill is suspended. The outcome is derived from the skill record, not a self-asserted boolean, and is consistent with the ask_before_use authority class which already forbids auto-execution. No live tenant write was performed.

skillUpdatesDeferred.deferredUpdate: Creating the live Council Skill row for CSK-LOCAL-DRIFT-SCAN-001 with com_status active is a receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2; no live tenant write was performed in this slice.

Creating the live Council Skill row for CSK-LOCAL-LEGACY-SUMMARIZE-001 with com_status deprecated is a receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2; any later move to retired is a separate receipt-backed mutation. No live tenant write was performed in this slice.

Creating the live Council Skill row for CSK-LOCAL-OUTBOUND-SEND-001 with com_status suspended is a receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2; any later move back to active after guardrail verification is a separate receipt-backed mutation. No live tenant write was performed in this slice.
